reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **November 3, 2025**.

- **Source for the date:** Moss's Coastal digest of Sun 11/2/2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own recap note from 2025-12-08 gives the same official date.
- **Day-to-day handover:** The recap note also says Bettina kept running the account through Nov 21 for the terminal cutover. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the tracker needs the operational start date.
